name: Nurgling

bonuses.name: Mischief Makers
bonuses.text: Nurglings complicate everything. Once they appear in a scene, any die roll that includes two or more 1s triggers a Wrath Complication. Characters with NURGLE keyword are immune to this effect.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 2 Fear Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 1d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock

mobAbilities.name: Mob Abilities
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Nurglings gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Nurglings.

note: Reprint of darktide-nurglings; differs in Shock (printed '-', Darktide 2), keywords (NURGLE, not MARK OF NURGLE) and the Mob ability (Darktide has none). Block header reads 'Nurglings'.
